gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-nko-unjoine: Expressive pipe-cleaner letterforms headline in Gabarito, each one looking drawn with a single nib. And Noto Sans NKo Unjoined, sans-serif with wide openings on small letters, keeps pages of text approachable and unhurried.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Gabarito's letters look drawn with a round-tipped pen, expressive and distinctive from the first glance. Noto Sans Shavian wins on one thing: rope-loose curves that never knot at the ends.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-philosopher: Round letters bent from wire give Gabarito its distinctive, expressive look. Gabarito is best at turning heads with that wire-like line, while Philosopher does its best work in soft shifts of thickness and curves full of daylight.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-pt-sans: Distinctive from the first line, Gabarito runs flat as fineliner on paper. Gabarito is best at grabbing the eye, while PT Sans, whose c forms read as open arcs, is best at staying approachable.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-reddit-sans: Gabarito looks drawn with one nib, its terminals cut open for a distinctive, expressive shape. Reddit Sans, sans-serif with a wide gap in its e and a thickness that ignores direction, lets the heading do the talking.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-rethink-sans: Loose and nib-drawn: that is Gabarito, with terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. And Rethink Sans holds the pair together with openings that stay generous at every weight.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-roboto-flex: Expressive Gabarito holds its line width through every turn. Give Gabarito generous size and let Roboto Flex, whose c leaves a wide slot between its ends, stay modest underneath.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-rosario: Gabarito lays down a plain stripe of constant ink. Rosario's c never curls its ends inward, which gives paragraphs a contemporary, approachable feel that carries comfortably down the page.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-sarabun: Expressive Gabarito gives its tails and terminals the weight of its stems. What lingers is Sarabun, sans-serif with every bowl opened wide, which keeps the clean, approachable text from fighting the heading.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-sarala: Sarala reads approachable and contemporary, its letters held open by distinct gaps. Gabarito is best at making an expressive entrance, while Sarala is best at carrying text in a thickness like neon glass tubing.
